column10: Natalie is our seasoned leader at Jakata. With 16 years in hairdressing, her knack for crafting unique styles along with her expert colour knowledge sets her apart as an exceptionally versatile stylist.
Senior Stylist Sarah effortlessly blends welcoming vibes with natural beauty, crafting stylish hair transformations that reflect her easygoing yet ambitious nature.
Our progressive stylist Katie is fuelled by a passion for hair transformations. Her artistic finesse and dedication, coupled with an award-winning touch, make her a captivating asset to Jakata.
Daisy is a creative and talented stylist at Jakata, dedicated to crafting unique hair transformations that boost confidence and exude style. She’s a master of extensions and creative colour.
Jasmine is inspired by the transformative power of hair. With a focus on balayage and fashion tones, she combines technical skill with a calm, client focused approach to every appointment.

Lily is our ultra talented graduate stylist at Jakata. Known for her confident, friendly approach and love of balayage. She brings a creative, people first energy to every appointment, focused on making clients feel their best.
